commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /tmp/repomesh-ci
node anchor/xrpl/scripts/compute-root.mjs --since-last | tee /tmp/repomesh-ci/compute-root.stdout.json
node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/tmp/repomesh-ci/compute-root.stdout.json","utf8"));process.stdout.write((j.eventCount===0||j.root==null)?"true":"false")' > /tmp/repomesh-ci/idle-flag
IDLE=$(cat /tmp/repomesh-ci/idle-flag)
echo "idle=${IDLE}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
if [ "$IDLE" = "true" ]; then
  echo "::notice::idle epoch, same tree, nothing to post"
fi
docker build -t repomesh:local .

set -euo pipefail
cleanup() { docker rm -f repomesh-post >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
docker run --name repomesh-post \
  -e XRPL_SEED \
  -e XRPL_WS_URL \
  -v "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/anchor/xrpl/partition-root.json:/opt/repomesh/anchor/xrpl/partition-root.json:ro" \
  --entrypoint node \
  repomesh:local \
  anchor/xrpl/scripts/post-anchor.mjs
docker cp repomesh-post:/opt/repomesh/anchor/xrpl/anchor-result.json "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/anchor/xrpl/anchor-result.json"

mkdir -p /tmp/repomesh-ci
node anchor/xrpl/scripts/emit-anchor-event.mjs --sign --output /tmp/repomesh-ci/anchor.jsonl

ANCHOR=$(wc -l < /tmp/repomesh-ci/anchor.jsonl 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
echo "anchor=$ANCHOR" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

commands.step: Append anchor event to ledger via PR
commands.text:
BRANCH="anchor/$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}.git"
git config user.name "repomesh-bot"
git config user.email "repomesh-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
git checkout -b "$BRANCH"
cat /tmp/repomesh-ci/anchor.jsonl >> ledger/events/events.jsonl
# LEDGER-A-001: regenerate the whole-ledger all.json manifest so validate-ledger's
# LOCAL immutability coverage spans the just-appended event. The --since-last partition
# (computed above) covers the new event ON-CHAIN; all.json keeps the FULL ledger locally
# tamper-evident. Without this, all.json goes stale every cycle and post-anchor events
# become unverifiable by `npm run validate:ledger` — the coverage gap the 2026-06-20
# dogfood swarm closed. (ledger/tests/immutability-coverage.test.mjs is the drift guard.)
rm -f anchor/xrpl/manifests/all.json
node anchor/xrpl/scripts/compute-root.mjs --all
# ANC-B02: rebuild registry/anchors.json from the just-appended anchor event so
# display surfaces (Pages dashboard, badges, snippets) pick up the new partition's
# txHash in the SAME commit. Without this, anchors.json lags by a cycle and live
# partitions render txHash:null ("not yet anchored") even after the on-chain post.
node registry/scripts/build-anchors.mjs
git add ledger/events/events.jsonl anchor/xrpl/manifests/*.json registry/anchors.json
git commit -m "anchor: XRPL partition $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)"
git push origin "$BRANCH"
PR_URL=$(gh pr create \
  --head "$BRANCH" \
  --title "anchor: XRPL partition $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \
  --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## RepoMesh XRPL Anchor
Merkle root of ledger partition anchored to XRPL testnet.
Ledger CI verifies schema + signatures; this PR auto-merges once validate-ledger is green.
EOF
)")
echo "Opened $PR_URL"
# STGB-CI-001 (close the loop): enable auto-merge so the anchor lands on main as soon as
# validate-ledger passes. Without this the daily anchor PRs pile up unmerged, the ledger on
# main FREEZES, and the LEDGER-A-001 coverage gap re-forms (exactly what happened 2026-06-15..21).
# Degrades gracefully if the repo hasn't enabled auto-merge yet (one-time operator action).
gh pr merge --auto --merge "$PR_URL" \
  || echo "::warning::Could not enable auto-merge on $PR_URL. Enable once: gh api -X PATCH repos/${{ github.repository }} -f allow_auto_merge=true (validate-ledger must be a required check)."
# STGB-CI-001 (staleness andon): if anchor PRs accumulate, the ledger on main is likely
# frozen — surface it loudly instead of failing silently.
OPEN_ANCHORS=$(gh pr list --search "anchor: XRPL partition in:title" --state open --json number --jq 'length' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [ "${OPEN_ANCHORS:-0}" -gt 2 ]; then
  echo "::warning::${OPEN_ANCHORS} anchor PRs are open — the ledger on main may be frozen. Drain oldest-first (gh pr update-branch then merge) and confirm auto-merge is enabled."
fi

TITLE="⚠ automation: anchor-xrpl is failing"
RUN="${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"
BODY="The daily XRPL anchor cron failed. The ledger on main may stop advancing (re-forming the LEDGER-A-001 coverage gap). Run: $RUN"
EXISTING=$(gh issue list --state open --search "$TITLE in:title" --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [ -n "$EXISTING" ]; then
  gh issue comment "$EXISTING" --body "Still failing — $RUN"
else
  gh issue create --title "$TITLE" --body "$BODY" --label automation-alert 2>/dev/null \
    || gh issue create --title "$TITLE" --body "$BODY"
fi
npm ci || npm install

mkdir -p /tmp/repomesh-ci /tmp/repomesh-ci/logs
node attestor/scripts/attest-release.mjs --scan-new --sign --output /tmp/repomesh-ci/attestations.jsonl 2>/tmp/repomesh-ci/logs/attestor.log || { echo "::warning::Attestor crashed (see logs)"; echo "attestor" >> /tmp/repomesh-ci/failures.txt; }

node verifiers/license/scripts/verify-license.mjs --scan-new --sign --output /tmp/repomesh-ci/license.jsonl 2>/tmp/repomesh-ci/logs/license.log || { echo "::warning::License verifier crashed (see logs)"; echo "license" >> /tmp/repomesh-ci/failures.txt; }

node verifiers/security/scripts/verify-security.mjs --scan-new --sign --output /tmp/repomesh-ci/security.jsonl 2>/tmp/repomesh-ci/logs/security.log || { echo "::warning::Security verifier crashed (see logs)"; echo "security" >> /tmp/repomesh-ci/failures.txt; }

node verifiers/repro/scripts/verify-repro.mjs --scan-new --sign --output /tmp/repomesh-ci/repro.jsonl 2>/tmp/repomesh-ci/logs/repro.log || { echo "::warning::Reproducibility verifier crashed (see logs)"; echo "repro" >> /tmp/repomesh-ci/failures.txt; }

# Exit 2 means "ledgerable violations were written", not a crash. Exit 1 (and anything
# else non-zero except 2) is a crash and must hit the andon below. Collapsing both into
# `||` dropped real PolicyViolation events and, with the old blank-line output, never
# distinguished "warnings only" from "checker died".
set +e
node policy/scripts/check-policy.mjs --sign --output /tmp/repomesh-ci/violations.jsonl 2>/tmp/repomesh-ci/logs/policy.log
policy_status=$?
set -e
if [ "$policy_status" -eq 0 ] || [ "$policy_status" -eq 2 ]; then
  echo "Policy check finished (exit $policy_status)."
else
  echo "::warning::Policy check crashed (see logs)"
  echo "policy" >> /tmp/repomesh-ci/failures.txt
fi

commands.step: Andon — halt on any verifier crash
commands.text:
if [ -s /tmp/repomesh-ci/failures.txt ]; then
  echo "::error::Verifier(s) crashed: $(tr '\n' ' ' < /tmp/repomesh-ci/failures.txt). Refusing to append a partial attestation set to the ledger — re-run after fixing."
  exit 1
fi
echo "All verifiers completed without crashing."

# Count non-blank lines. `wc -l` treats a warnings-only "\n" file as 1 event, which
# is what sent this job into the append step with nothing the normalizer would keep.
count_jsonl() {
  local f="$1"
  if [ ! -s "$f" ]; then
    echo 0
    return
  fi
  local n
  n=$(grep -cve '^[[:space:]]*$' "$f" || true)
  echo "${n:-0}"
}
ATTESTATIONS=$(count_jsonl /tmp/repomesh-ci/attestations.jsonl)
LICENSE=$(count_jsonl /tmp/repomesh-ci/license.jsonl)
SECURITY=$(count_jsonl /tmp/repomesh-ci/security.jsonl)
REPRO=$(count_jsonl /tmp/repomesh-ci/repro.jsonl)
VIOLATIONS=$(count_jsonl /tmp/repomesh-ci/violations.jsonl)
TOTAL=$((ATTESTATIONS + LICENSE + SECURITY + REPRO + VIOLATIONS))
echo "total=$TOTAL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "attestations=$ATTESTATIONS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "license=$LICENSE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "security=$SECURITY" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "repro=$REPRO" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "violations=$VIOLATIONS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Attestations: $ATTESTATIONS, License: $LICENSE, Security: $SECURITY, Repro: $REPRO, Violations: $VIOLATIONS, Total: $TOTAL"

OPEN=$(gh pr list --search "attestor/" --state open --json number --jq 'length' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
echo "open=$OPEN" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
if [ "$OPEN" -gt "0" ]; then
  echo "Attestor PR already open — skipping to avoid PR pile-up."
fi

commands.step: Append events to ledger via PR
commands.text:
BRANCH="attestor/$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"

git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}.git"
git config user.name "repomesh-bot"
git config user.email "repomesh-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
git checkout -b "$BRANCH"

# Append attestation events
if [ -s /tmp/repomesh-ci/attestations.jsonl ]; then
  cat /tmp/repomesh-ci/attestations.jsonl >> ledger/events/events.jsonl
fi

# Append license verifier events
if [ -s /tmp/repomesh-ci/license.jsonl ]; then
  cat /tmp/repomesh-ci/license.jsonl >> ledger/events/events.jsonl
fi

# Append security verifier events
if [ -s /tmp/repomesh-ci/security.jsonl ]; then
  cat /tmp/repomesh-ci/security.jsonl >> ledger/events/events.jsonl
fi

# Append reproducibility verifier events
if [ -s /tmp/repomesh-ci/repro.jsonl ]; then
  cat /tmp/repomesh-ci/repro.jsonl >> ledger/events/events.jsonl
fi

# Append violation events
if [ -s /tmp/repomesh-ci/violations.jsonl ]; then
  cat /tmp/repomesh-ci/violations.jsonl >> ledger/events/events.jsonl
fi

# Normalize: concatenating multiple verifier outputs can leave a blank/whitespace-only line
# (a source file without a trailing newline, or an empty one), which validate-ledger rejects
# (LDG-004). Strip blank lines + guarantee a single trailing newline — one JSON event per line.
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='ledger/events/events.jsonl';const ls=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').split('\n').filter(l=>l.trim().length>0);fs.writeFileSync(f,ls.join('\n')+'\n');"

git add ledger/events/events.jsonl
# Blank-only appends normalize back to the committed ledger. `git commit` then exits 1
# under `bash -e` ("nothing to commit") and the failure alert fires. An unchanged tree
# is a clean no-op, not a failed run.
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "Ledger unchanged after blank-line normalize — nothing to append."
  exit 0
fi
git commit -m "attestor: ${{ steps.check.outputs.attestations }} attestation(s), ${{ steps.check.outputs.license }} license, ${{ steps.check.outputs.security }} security, ${{ steps.check.outputs.repro }} repro, ${{ steps.check.outputs.violations }} violation(s)"
git push origin "$BRANCH"

PR_URL=$(gh pr create \
  --head "$BRANCH" \
  --title "attestor: ${{ steps.check.outputs.attestations }} attestation(s), ${{ steps.check.outputs.license }} license, ${{ steps.check.outputs.security }} security, ${{ steps.check.outputs.repro }} repro" \
  --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## RepoMesh Attestor Run

**Attestations:** ${{ steps.check.outputs.attestations }}
**License Audits:** ${{ steps.check.outputs.license }}
**Security Scans:** ${{ steps.check.outputs.security }}
**Repro Builds:** ${{ steps.check.outputs.repro }}
**Policy Violations:** ${{ steps.check.outputs.violations }}

Automated attestor + verifier + policy scan. Ledger CI verifies schema + signatures; this PR auto-merges on green.
EOF
)")
echo "Opened $PR_URL"
# Close the loop (same as anchor-xrpl): auto-merge on green so attestor PRs don't pile up
# unmerged + freeze the ledger. Degrades gracefully if allow_auto_merge isn't enabled.
gh pr merge --auto --merge "$PR_URL" \
  || echo "::warning::Could not enable auto-merge on $PR_URL. Enable once: gh api -X PATCH repos/${{ github.repository }} -f allow_auto_merge=true."

TITLE="⚠ automation: attestor-ci is failing"
RUN="${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"
BODY="The attestor/verifier/policy cron failed (a verifier crashed, or the run errored). Attestations may be missing from the ledger. Run: $RUN"
EXISTING=$(gh issue list --state open --search "$TITLE in:title" --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [ -n "$EXISTING" ]; then
  gh issue comment "$EXISTING" --body "Still failing — $RUN"
else
  gh issue create --title "$TITLE" --body "$BODY" --label automation-alert 2>/dev/null \
    || gh issue create --title "$TITLE" --body "$BODY"
fi
npx --yes @dogfood-lab/atlas@1.14.0 check
npm ci || npm install

set -euo pipefail
BASE_REF="origin/main:ledger/events/events.jsonl"

# 1. The ref itself must resolve. If origin/main is missing, the checkout/fetch is
#    broken — that is an ERROR, never an empty base.
if ! git rev-parse --verify --quiet origin/main >/dev/null; then
  echo "::error::Cannot resolve origin/main. The base ledger could not be fetched"
  echo "::error::(fetch-depth/checkout failure). Refusing to validate against an EMPTY base,"
  echo "::error::which would silently skip the append-only/immutability check (LEDGER-A-007)."
  exit 1
fi

# 2. Does the ledger path exist in origin/main?
if git cat-file -e "${BASE_REF}" 2>/dev/null; then
  # Path exists → extract it. A failure HERE (blob unreadable) is a hard error.
  git show "${BASE_REF}" > /tmp/base-events.jsonl
  echo "Base ledger extracted ($(wc -l < /tmp/base-events.jsonl) line(s))."
else
  # Path absent on main. This is EITHER a legitimate first/bootstrap commit OR a
  # path/ref error. Only accept the empty base when explicitly authorized.
  if [ "${LEDGER_ALLOW_EMPTY_BASE:-}" = "1" ]; then
    echo "::warning::ledger/events/events.jsonl absent on origin/main and"
    echo "::warning::LEDGER_ALLOW_EMPTY_BASE=1 — treating as first commit (empty base)."
    : > /tmp/base-events.jsonl
  else
    echo "::error::ledger/events/events.jsonl not found in origin/main."
    echo "::error::Refusing to fall open to an empty base (LEDGER-A-007): an empty base"
    echo "::error::SKIPS the append-only/immutability check. If this is a genuine first"
    echo "::error::commit, set repo variable LEDGER_ALLOW_EMPTY_BASE=1 to authorize it."
    exit 1
  fi
fi
npm run validate:ledger

echo "::error::Ledger validation failed. Check the validator output above for details."
echo "::error::Common causes: schema violation, invalid signature, duplicate event, or timestamp issue."
echo "::error::See docs/handbook.md CI Troubleshooting section for resolution steps."
node registry/scripts/build-anchors.mjs
node registry/scripts/build-badges.mjs
node registry/scripts/build-snippets.mjs
node pages/build-metrics.mjs
node pages/build-timeline.mjs

node pages/build-pages.mjs
mkdir -p site/public
cp -r pages/out/* site/public/
node pages/build-stats.mjs
npm ci
npm run build

set -e
node registry/scripts/build-registry.mjs
node registry/scripts/build-trust.mjs
node registry/scripts/build-dependencies.mjs
node registry/scripts/build-verifiers.mjs
node registry/scripts/build-anchors.mjs
node registry/scripts/build-badges.mjs
node registry/scripts/build-snippets.mjs

git add registry/nodes.json registry/capabilities.json registry/trust.json registry/dependencies.json registry/verifiers.json registry/anchors.json registry/badges/ registry/snippets/
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "No registry changes — committed registry is in sync with the ledger."
  exit 0
fi
BRANCH="registry/auto-$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
git config user.name "repomesh-bot"
git config user.email "repomesh-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}.git"
git checkout -b "$BRANCH"
git commit -m "registry: auto-update derived indexes (trust, verifiers, anchors, badges, snippets)"
git push origin "$BRANCH"
PR=$(gh pr create --head "$BRANCH" --base main \
  --title "registry: auto-update derived indexes" \
  --body "Automated registry regeneration after a ledger change — registry-ci cannot push to protected main, so this lands the derived indexes via an auto-merging PR.")
gh pr merge --auto --merge "$PR" \
  || echo "::warning::Could not enable auto-merge on $PR. Enable once: gh api -X PATCH repos/${{ github.repository }} -f allow_auto_merge=true."

commands.step: Install npm >= 11.5 in sandbox for OIDC trusted-publishing auth
commands.text:
# Node 22 bundles npm 10.x, which cannot do OIDC trusted publishing,
# and an in-place `npm i -g npm@latest` races its own arborist rebuild.
# Install npm@latest into an isolated sandbox and shadow it via PATH.
SANDBOX="$HOME/.npm-cli-sandbox"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"
pushd "$SANDBOX" >/dev/null
echo '{"name":"npm-cli-sandbox","version":"0.0.0","private":true}' > package.json
npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --silent npm@latest
popd >/dev/null
echo "$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
"$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin/npm" --version
npm ci

commands.step: Verify release tag matches package.json version
commands.text:
PKG_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
echo "Tag: ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} -> ${TAG_VERSION} | Package: ${PKG_VERSION}"
if [ "${PKG_VERSION}" != "${TAG_VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "::error::Release tag ${TAG_VERSION} does not match package.json version ${PKG_VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi
node scripts/build.mjs
node --test tests/*.test.mjs
npm pack --dry-run

npm audit --audit-level=high --omit=dev
npm audit --audit-level=high --omit=dev --prefix anchor/xrpl

commands.step: Publish to npm with provenance (OIDC trusted publisher)
commands.text: npm publish --provenance --access public

VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "release" ]; then
  TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
  if [ "$VERSION" != "$TAG_VERSION" ]; then
    echo "::error::Release tag ${TAG_VERSION} does not match package.json version ${VERSION}"
    exit 1
  fi
fi
IMAGE="ghcr.io/$(echo '${{ github.repository }}' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
echo "image=$IMAGE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "${{ github.token }}" | docker login ghcr.io -u "${{ github.actor }}" --password-stdin

docker build \
  -t "${{ steps.tags.outputs.image }}:${{ steps.tags.outputs.version }}" \
  -t "${{ steps.tags.outputs.image }}:sha-${GITHUB_SHA}" \
  .
docker push "${{ steps.tags.outputs.image }}:${{ steps.tags.outputs.version }}"
docker push "${{ steps.tags.outputs.image }}:sha-${GITHUB_SHA}"
npm ci
npm run build --workspaces --if-present

mkdir -p /tmp/repomesh
npm pack -w @mcptoolshop/repomesh --pack-destination /tmp/repomesh >/dev/null
sha256sum /tmp/repomesh/*.tgz > /tmp/repomesh/artifact-hashes.txt
cat /tmp/repomesh/artifact-hashes.txt

npm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx > /tmp/repomesh/sbom.json 2>/dev/null || echo '{"bomFormat":"CycloneDX","specVersion":"1.4","components":[]}' > /tmp/repomesh/sbom.json
sha256sum /tmp/repomesh/sbom.json | awk '{print $1}' > /tmp/repomesh/sbom-hash.txt
echo "SBOM generated ($(wc -c < /tmp/repomesh/sbom.json) bytes)"

VERSION="${{ inputs.version || github.ref_name }}"
gh release upload "$VERSION" /tmp/repomesh/sbom.json --clobber 2>/dev/null || echo "SBOM upload skipped"
gh release upload "$VERSION" /tmp/repomesh/provenance.json --clobber 2>/dev/null || echo "Provenance upload skipped"

REPO_SLUG="${{ github.event.repository.name }}"
VERSION="${{ inputs.version || github.ref_name }}"
BRANCH="event/${REPO_SLUG}/${VERSION}"

gh repo clone "${{ env.REPOMESH_LEDGER_REPO }}" /tmp/repomesh-ledger -- --depth 1
cd /tmp/repomesh-ledger

git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${{ env.REPOMESH_LEDGER_REPO }}.git"
git config user.name "repomesh-bot"
git config user.email "repomesh-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
git checkout -b "$BRANCH"

cat /tmp/repomesh/event.json >> ledger/events/events.jsonl
printf '\n' >> ledger/events/events.jsonl

git add ledger/events/events.jsonl
git commit -m "event: ${{ github.repository }}@${VERSION}"
git push origin "$BRANCH"

PR_URL=$(gh pr create \
  --repo "${{ env.REPOMESH_LEDGER_REPO }}" \
  --head "$BRANCH" \
  --title "event: ${{ github.repository }}@${VERSION}" \
  --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## RepoMesh Broadcast

**Repo:** ${{ github.repository }}
**Version:** ${{ inputs.version || github.ref_name }}
**Commit:** ${{ github.sha }}
**Type:** ReleasePublished

Automated event from release workflow. Ledger CI verifies schema, signature, and append-only; this PR auto-merges on green.
EOF
)")
echo "Opened $PR_URL"
# Close the loop: auto-merge on green so release-event PRs don't pile up unmerged (the
# ledger should record every release). Degrades gracefully if allow_auto_merge is off.
gh pr merge --auto --merge --repo "${{ env.REPOMESH_LEDGER_REPO }}" "$PR_URL" \
  || echo "::warning::Could not enable auto-merge on $PR_URL — ensure allow_auto_merge is enabled on ${{ env.REPOMESH_LEDGER_REPO }}."
cd anchor/xrpl && npm ci

commands.step: Compare rippled and amendments to the baseline
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
node anchor/xrpl/scripts/watch.mjs > /tmp/xrpl-watch.json
cat /tmp/xrpl-watch.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
CHANGED=$(node -e 'const j=require("node:fs").readFileSync("/tmp/xrpl-watch.json","utf8"); process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(j).changed ? "true" : "false")')
echo "changed=$CHANGED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

commands.step: Open an issue when the watched surface changes
commands.text:
TITLE="xrpl-watch: protocol surface changed"
BODY=$(cat /tmp/xrpl-watch.json)
EXISTING=$(gh issue list --state open --search "$TITLE in:title" --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [ -n "$EXISTING" ]; then
  gh issue comment "$EXISTING" --body "$(printf '%s\n\n```json\n%s\n```' "Still different from anchor/xrpl/watch-baseline.json." "$BODY")"
else
  gh issue create --title "$TITLE" --body "$(printf '%s\n\n```json\n%s\n```' "anchor/xrpl/watch-baseline.json does not match the live rippled release or the Batch/Sponsor enabled flags. Update the baseline only after a human accepts the change. Do not add those transaction types from this issue." "$BODY")"
fi
